DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の確認でお越しですね。こちらの写真をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here to check a bicycle, correct? Please look at this photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 色が同じなので、私の自転車だと思います。今日このまま持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の色から自分の自転車だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The color matches, so I think it is mine. Can I take it home today as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought it was your bicycle based on the photo's color. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の色だけで所有者を確認することはできません。登録番号などは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ownership cannot be verified from the photograph's color alone. Do you know the registration number or similar details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えを家に置いてきました。番号は覚えていませんが、買った店の名前は分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録控えを持参せず番号は不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left the registration slip at home. I do not remember the number, but I know the shop where I bought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not bring the registration slip and do not know the number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 所有を確認できる資料について担当者がご案内します。特徴を追加で説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will explain documents that can establish ownership. Can you describe any additional features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後ろの荷台に小さい傷があります。ただ、この写真では傷が見えるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加の傷の特徴と写真では確認できない範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a small scratch on the rear rack. However, I cannot tell whether the scratch is visible in this photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the additional scratch detail and the limits of what you can confirm from the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。推測で番号を書く必要はありません。資料を確認してから引き取りをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You need not guess and write a number. We will explain collection after checking the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今日は自分の物だと断定せず、必要な資料を教えてもらって家で控えを探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所有を断定せず必要資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then today I will not assert it is mine. I will ask what documents are needed and look for the slip at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about required documents without asserting ownership. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、控えが見つからない場合の確認方法も担当者に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can also ask the staff how to verify it if you cannot find the slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。購入店への確認が必要かも聞き、資料がそろってから改めて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えや購入店の確認後に引き取りを相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will also ask whether checking with the shop is necessary, and come again once the documents are ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to discuss collection after checking the slip or purchase shop. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は特徴を記録し、所有確認の担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Today we will record the features and refer you to the ownership-verification staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 中身を具体的に教えていただけますか。「プレゼント」だけでは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me the specific contents? “Present” alone is not enough to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもに送るおもちゃです。贈り物なので、詳しく書かなくてもいいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈り物の具体的な中身を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a toy for a child. Since it is a gift, I thought I did not need to describe it in detail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the gift's specific contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: おもちゃに電池などは入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the toy contain batteries or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、充電して動く物です。電池の種類は分かりませんが、箱の説明書はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電池付きで種類不明だが説明書があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It works after charging. I do not know the battery type, but I have the instructions from the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it has a battery of unknown type but you have the instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明書を確認しましょう。発送できるかや方法は、中身と送付先の条件で確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the instructions. Whether and how it can be sent requires checking the contents and destination conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 送付先は国内の親戚です。説明書を出します。分からない電池の種類を適当に書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送付先を示し不明な電池情報を推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient is a relative in Japan. I will take out the instructions. I will not just guess and write the unknown battery type.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the destination and say you will not guess unknown battery details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者が表示を確認します。まだ発送を受け付けてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. The staff will check the labeling. We have not yet accepted it for dispatch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。「おもちゃ」と具体的に書き、電池の情報は確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 具体的な品名を書き電池欄は確認後に記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will write the specific item name “toy” and fill in battery details after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the specific item name and complete battery details after confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。送れることが確定する前に、通常の方法で発送できるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before eligibility is confirmed, we cannot promise it can be sent by the regular method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認の結果を待ちます。送れない場合は別の贈り物を考え、無理にそのまま出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認を待ち発送できなければ別案を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the result. If it cannot be sent, I will consider another gift rather than insist on sending it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will await the conditions check and choose another option if it cannot be sent. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明書と送付先をもとに、発送条件を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask the staff about shipping conditions based on the instructions and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のご相談ですね。必要な情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a transfer. Do you have the required information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この札に十一時とあるので、その時刻に相手へ送られるんですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 整理券の時刻が送金時刻なのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This ticket says eleven o'clock, so the money will be sent to the recipient then, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the queue ticket time is the remittance time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは窓口の受付時刻です。振込の受付や実行時刻を示す札ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is your counter reception time, not a ticket showing transfer acceptance or execution time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札を取っただけで、振込を予約したと思っていました。まだ情報を何も出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札取得だけで振込予約したと誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought simply taking the ticket booked a transfer. I have not provided any information yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook taking a ticket for booking a transfer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。まず振込先と金額を確認して手続きを行います。希望する支払い期限はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. First we check the recipient and amount and carry out the procedure. Is there a payment deadline you want to meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手は今日中に欲しいと言っています。窓口の待ち時間だけで、到着時刻を判断してはいけませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の期限を示し待ち時間から到着を判断しないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient wants it today. I should not infer arrival time just from the counter waiting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the recipient's deadline and understand not to infer arrival from waiting time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込方法や受付条件を確認し、可能な範囲をご案内します。到着をここで確約することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the transfer method and acceptance conditions and explain what is possible. We cannot guarantee arrival here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では条件を聞いてから決めます。間に合わない場合に相手と相談するため、案内された内容をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件を確認し相手への相談用に記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will hear the conditions before deciding. I would like to note the guidance so I can discuss with the recipient if it cannot arrive in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check conditions and note the guidance for discussion with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。ご案内後、実行するかを確認します。札を取ったことだけで手続きは済んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. After explaining, we will confirm whether to proceed. Taking the queue ticket alone does not complete the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。整理券の受付と振込手続きを分けて考え、条件を確認してから依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付札と送金手続きを区別して確認後に依頼すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will distinguish queue-ticket reception from the transfer procedure and request it after checking conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the queue ticket from remittance and decide to request after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず必要な情報とご本人確認についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we will explain the necessary information and identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートのどの金額についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which amount on the receipt are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二千円と書いてあります。買い物は千二百円だと思ったので、多く払ったのか気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レシートの二千円が想定総額より高いと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 2,000 yen. I thought my shopping was 1,200 yen, so I wondered whether I overpaid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why the receipt's 2,000 yen exceeds the expected total. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二千円は「お預り」の欄ですね。お支払いに出された現金はいくらでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The 2,000 yen is in the “cash received” field. How much cash did you hand over?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二千円を出しました。では、この欄は商品の合計ではなく、店へ渡した額なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 渡した現金の額と預り欄の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I gave 2,000 yen. So this field is the amount handed to the shop, not the goods total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the cash handed over and the meaning of the cash-received field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。合計は千二百円、釣銭は八百円と記載されています。お返しした現金はまだ分けてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The total is 1,200 yen and change 800 yen. Have you kept the returned cash separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このトレーにあります。財布にもともとあった三百円とは混ぜていません。ここで八百円か数えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 釣銭を持参現金と分けていると伝え確認場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is in this tray. I have not mixed it with the 300 yen already in my wallet. May I count whether it is 800 yen here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the change is separate from prior cash and ask where to check it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、机の上でご確認ください。違いがあれば、財布へ入れる前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, check on the desk. If there is any difference, tell us before putting it in your wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五百円一枚、百円三枚で八百円です。商品の合計と受け取った釣銭で、二千円になると分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八百円の内訳と合計千二百円との関係を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One 500-yen coin and three 100-yen coins make 800 yen. I understand that the goods total plus the change received equals 2,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the 800-yen breakdown and its relation to the 1,200-yen total. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。商品の購入内容については変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for checking. Do you wish to change any of the purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更はありません。返金の依頼ではなく金額の読み方の確認でした。釣銭とレシートをしまって帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入変更や返金でなく表示確認だと伝え現金と記録を収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: No changes. This was about reading the amounts, not requesting a refund. I will put away the change and receipt and leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify this is a display check, not a purchase change or refund, and put away cash and record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。レシートの合計、お預り、釣銭はそれぞれの欄でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check the total, cash received, and change in their respective receipt fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その通路は今、工事で通れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That passage is currently closed for construction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地図では池までの近道になっています。柵の横を歩けば抜けられそうですが、だめですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図の近道と現地の閉鎖について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The map shows it as a shortcut to the pond. It looks possible beside the fence; is that not allowed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the map's shortcut and the closure on site. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図の線があっても、閉鎖中の通路は使えません。柵の脇も入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even with a line on the map, a closed passage cannot be used. Do not enter beside the fence either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。地図より今日の案内に従います。池まで行ける別の道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現地案内を優先し別経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will follow today's guidance rather than the map. Is there another route to the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prioritize local guidance and ask for another route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では外周の道が使えます。ただし近道より時間がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, the outer path is available, but it takes longer than the shortcut.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族を池の前で待たせています。遠回りになると連絡してから、外周へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠回りを待つ家族に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family is waiting at the pond. I will tell them I need a detour before heading to the outer path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will notify your waiting family about the detour. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。途中の分かれ道にも工事の案内があります。表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. There are construction notices at the forks along the way too. Check the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし外周も閉じている表示があれば、柵を越えず、また入口へ戻って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別経路も閉鎖表示があれば戻って相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If a sign says the outer path is closed too, I will not climb the fence; I will return to the entrance and ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to return for advice if the alternative route also has a closure sign. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。今ご案内できるのは、開いている外周の道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. The route we can currently recommend is the open outer path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。地図の近道は使わず、表示を見ながら進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 近道を使わず現地表示に従って進むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not use the map's shortcut and will proceed while checking signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm following local signs instead of the shortcut. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。外周は右の道です。家族との連絡を済ませてからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The outer path is to the right. Please contact your family before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: きっぷのご相談でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。電車には乗りません。改札の中の店へ行きたいので、一番安い乗車券を買えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車せず改札内の店を利用する目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am not riding a train. I want a shop inside the gates, so should I buy the cheapest travel ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want the shop inside the gates without taking a train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗車する場合と、駅の中へ入るだけの場合では扱いが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Taking a train and merely entering the station are handled differently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行き先がないのに、近くの駅まで買おうとしていました。入るだけの方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行き先のない乗車券購入をやめ入場方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was going to buy to a nearby station despite having no destination. Please tell me how to enter only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop buying a travel ticket without a destination and ask how to enter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では入場券をご案内できます。ただし、入場券で列車には乗れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation we can offer a platform admission ticket, but it does not permit train travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。店で買い物したあと、そのまま列車で帰りたくなった場合はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後で乗車したくなった場合の対応を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. What if after shopping I decide I want to take a train home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check what to do if you later want to travel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車する前に、必要なきっぷを係員へ確認してください。入場券のまま乗らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before boarding, check the required ticket with the staff. Do not board with only an admission ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は買い物だけにします。使える時間や出る改札に条件があるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買い物だけに決め利用時間などの条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will just shop. I also want to know any conditions on usage time or the exit gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide on shopping only and ask about time and other conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入場券の利用条件をこちらでご説明します。確認してから購入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain admission-ticket conditions here. Let's check before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。乗車券の代わりだとは考えず、利用条件を聞いて入場券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入場券と乗車券を区別して条件確認後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not treat it as a travel-ticket substitute; I will hear the conditions and buy an admission ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish admission and travel tickets and buy after checking conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。買い物だけのご利用として、入場券の条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. For shopping only, we will explain admission-ticket conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 代理での手続きについてですね。書類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a procedure on behalf of someone else. Let me check the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父に頼まれて来ました。父の名前の欄が空いているので、ここで私が書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 代理依頼を受け空欄を自分で埋めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father asked me to come. His name field is blank; should I fill it in here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were asked to act as representative and ask whether you may fill the blank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の意思や署名の確認が必要な欄です。代理人が代わりに埋めればよいとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field requires confirmation of his intent or signature. A representative cannot necessarily fill it in instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父から頼まれたことと、父の署名を書くことは別なんですね。まだ何も書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼された事実と本人署名の代筆を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Being asked by my father and writing his signature are different. I will not write anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish being asked from signing for the person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。どの手続きを頼まれたかと、本人から受け取った書類を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let's check which procedure you were asked to do and the documents received from him.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の証明書の申請です。父が用意したのはこの用紙だけで、署名の方法までは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象の申請と受け取った書類の範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: An application for his certificate. He prepared only this form, and I have not asked how the signature should be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the application and the extent of documents received. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では担当者が必要な書類と本人確認の方法を説明します。今の状態では受付完了とはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here the staff will explain required documents and identity checks. Acceptance is not complete in this state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。電話で頼まれたと説明するだけで済むとは考えず、必要な方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口頭の依頼だけで完了と考えず必要な確認方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not assume saying he asked by phone is enough; I will ask the required method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not treat verbal authorization as sufficient; ask the required verification method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。ご本人が書けない事情がある場合も、その事情を担当者へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. If he has circumstances preventing him from writing, discuss those with the staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 父には書類の条件を伝えます。私が父の署名を作らず、確認してから準備し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 署名を作らず条件を本人へ伝えて準備すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my father the document requirements. I will not create his signature; I will check and prepare again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to create a signature and to tell the person the conditions before preparing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。空欄はそのままにして、代理手続きの担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Leave the field blank; we will direct you to the representative-procedure staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 佐藤直子様、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ms. Naoko Sato, please come here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 佐藤ですが、私の名前は優子です。同じ姓なので立ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ姓だが名前が違うと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am Sato, but my given name is Yuko. I stood up because the surname matched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the surname matches but the given name differs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前が違いますね。まだ中へ入らず、受付番号も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name differs. Do not enter yet; let's check your reception number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私の番号は二十四番です。呼ばれた番号までは聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の番号と聞き取れなかった範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, mine is 24. I did not catch the number called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your own number and say what you did not hear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今お呼びしたのは別の方です。お客様はまだお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person just called is someone else. Please keep waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。ほかの方の順番が自分より早い理由を聞くより、自分の呼び出し方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の順番ではなく自分の呼び出し方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than ask why someone else is earlier, I want to check how I will be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how you will be called rather than about another person's order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様のお名前と番号でお呼びします。表示にも番号が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will call your name and number. The number also appears on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 耳から聞くだけでは間違えそうなので、番号表示も見ます。名前が似ていたら入る前に尋ねていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号表示を併用し不明時は入室前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Listening alone might cause a mistake, so I will check the display too. If a name sounds similar, may I ask before entering?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the number display too and ask to confirm before entering if unclear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、分からなければスタッフに確認してください。姓だけで判断しなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, ask staff if unsure. You need not decide from the surname alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二十四番と自分の名前を確認してから返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と本人名が合ってから応答すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will respond after confirming 24 and my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to respond only once your number and name match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は待合席でお待ちください。お客様の順番で改めてお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Wait in the waiting area now. We will call again when it is your turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談に関係する記録をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have records relevant to the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、携帯電話に録音があります。ただ、友人との別の会話も同じファイルに入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 関連する録音に別の会話も含まれると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a recording on my phone. But the same file includes another conversation with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the relevant recording includes a different conversation too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談に関係する部分は、どのあたりか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where the relevant part is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始まって十二分ごろからです。全部をここで大きな音で流す前に、聞いてもらう方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 関連部分の開始位置を示し再生方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: From about twelve minutes in. Before playing all of it loudly here, I want to check how you can listen to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the relevant start position and check the playback method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲に流さず、担当者へ内容と時間を説明してください。提出方法は担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not play it to the surroundings. Explain the content and time to the staff, who will check submission methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。分かりやすくするために、元のファイルの前半を消そうとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の記録を自分で削除しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not delete the first half of the original to make it easier to follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not delete the original record yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、自己判断で元の記録を書き換えず、その状態を担当者に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Do not alter the original on your own; tell the staff its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で録音が止まった所もあります。聞こえない部分の言葉を、覚えたつもりで補わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音の途切れを示し記憶で音声を補わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The recording also stops at some points. I will not fill inaudible words with what I think I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out recording gaps and say you will not supplement the audio from memory. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる記録と、お客様の記憶は分けて伺います。必要な受け渡し方法もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will distinguish verifiable records from your memory, and explain any necessary handover method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。関係する開始時刻と録音が途切れた位置をメモして、元のファイルを持ったまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 該当時間と途切れを整理し元のファイルで担当者に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will note the relevant start time and the gaps, and consult while retaining the original file.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the relevant timing and gaps and consult the staff with the original file. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付では再生せず、記録の確認担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Do not play it at reception; we will direct you to the staff who check records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお荷物を返品としてお送りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this parcel as a return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。送ればお金も戻ると思うので、返品の発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送で返金も始まると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I think sending it will get my money back too, so please dispatch the return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought dispatch would also start the refund. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返金や返品の受付は販売元が判断します。販売元への返品申請は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The seller decides refund and return acceptance. Have you applied to return it to the seller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。商品ページの住所を見て、先に荷物を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売元への返品申請が未済だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I saw the address on the product page and brought the parcel first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not applied for a return to the seller. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その住所が返品先とは限りません。販売元の案内を確認してから発送できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That address is not necessarily the returns address. It can be dispatched after checking the seller's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では今は送らないでください。返品の受付番号や送付先を販売元に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を止め受付番号と返品先を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then do not send it now. I will ask the seller for a return acceptance number and destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop dispatch and say you will check the return number and address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。送料をどちらが負担するかも、販売元の条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Also check the seller's terms on who pays postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。郵便局で返金を決めてもらう話ではないので、販売元の返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金判断と郵便局の発送を分け販売元の返事を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. This is not for the post office to decide the refund, so I will await the seller's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate refund decisions from postal dispatch and await the seller's reply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、返答後に発送方法と料金をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After the reply, you can discuss dispatch methods and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。商品は持ち帰り、返品が受け付けられたことと正しい送付先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品を持ち帰り返品受付と送付先を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will take the item home and confirm the return has been accepted and the correct destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take it home and confirm return acceptance and address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は発送せず、確認後にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will not send it today. Please bring it after checking.
